svg.title: Agentic canyon, round 2: desktop sunset frame in the light theme page chrome
svg.desc: The scene (Flexoki, identical in both themes) sits under the site top bar; a stratum card on the solid --card surface sits in the left max-w-md column. Chrome colours are the light tokens from front-end/src/index.css.

g.data-pillar: Coverage floors that only ratchet up
podman kube play with an update timer and automatic rollback
Hive's agents: scanner, architect, quality, craftsman and strategist

svg.text: A Fastify server serves the content and counts
article views in SQLite; front-end and back-end
